question: How many times faster is delamination at the boiling point of ethylene glycol than at 160 °C, and what is that boiling point?

trace.query: SELECT id, page, text, strength FROM atoms WHERE (kind LIKE '%ocr%' AND page=4 AND figure_id IS NOT NULL) OR (text ILIKE '%boiling%') OR (text ILIKE '%197%' ) OR (text ILIKE '%160%') OR (text ILIKE '%delaminat%time%') ORDER BY page, id

Delamination at the boiling point is therefore faster by a factor of 3[5] times, the ratio of the delamination times. The temperature trend is shown in the figure below.Fig. 4[6]
